rule.name: SpringTransactionalReadOnlyWrite
rule.message: Put @Transactional without readOnly on this method: a write inside a read-only transaction is skipped or fails.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] [AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'readOnly']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]] or (not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.transaction.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.transaction.Transactional')]) and ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] [AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'readOnly']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]])] //(MethodCall | MethodReference)[ (@MethodName = ('save', 'saveAll', 'saveAndFlush', 'saveAllAndFlush', 'delete', 'deleteAll', 'deleteById', 'deleteAllById', 'deleteAllInBatch', 'persist', 'merge', 'remove') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager'))]) or (matches(@MethodName, '^(update|delete|remove|mark|set|rename|insert|upsert|increment|decrement|reset|clear|purge|archive|touch)([A-Z\d_]|$)') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository')])]
